info.title: Dashboard Plus helper API
info.summary: Let a program look at parts of the household's records and suggest new ones.
info.description: The helper API of Dashboard Plus, a local-first household records app. It runs on this computer only (127.0.0.1) and the port changes each time the app opens: Settings, Helpers shows the address. Every route needs `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, a key the household made for one helper. Helpers can look at the tables they were given and suggest NEW records; nothing is added until a person accepts it on Review. Private details are never shared. Requests from web pages are refused. This description is itself served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json and needs the same key. All examples are invented.

post.description: Suggestions only ever ADD records, and only wait on Review until a person accepts or rejects each one. Up to 50 entries and 65,536 bytes per request, 200 suggested rows per helper per UTC day, and at most `limits.review_queue_limit` of the helper's suggestions waiting on Review at once. Send the same `request_key` and body again to retry safely: you get the first answer (200) and nothing is added twice. A request that would take the helper over its Review limit is refused whole with `review_queue_full`.

helperKey.description: A key starting `dph_`, made in Settings, Helpers and shown once. Only the Authorization header is read.

error.description: A short code to act on: `no_key`: The key is missing, wrong or turned off. `from_a_web_page`: The request carried an Origin header, so it came from a web page. `forbidden`: The request named a host other than this computer. `bad_request`: The request could not be read, or a field of it is missing or the wrong kind. `looks_like_a_key`: Some text looked like a helper key. It is never kept or repeated. `hidden_characters`: Some text had hidden or text-reversing characters. Line breaks are fine. `not_allowed`: A field links into a part of the records this helper was not given. `private_detail`: A suggestion named a private detail, which helpers never share. `look_only`: This helper may look but not suggest. `not_found`: No such table, record or batch for this helper. A table in a part the helper was not given answers exactly like one that does not exist. `method_not_allowed`: That address does not accept this method. `request_key_reused`: The request key was already used for different suggestions. `too_large`: The body is over 65,536 bytes. `needs_json`: The body must be JSON with Content-Type application/json. `invalid`: Some values could not be used. Nothing was saved. `problems` names entry, table and field. `daily_limit`: The helper has already sent its suggestions for today (UTC). `review_queue_full`: Too many of this helper's suggestions are already waiting on Review. Nothing was saved. No Retry-After: the wait is for a person, not a clock. `too_many_requests`: More requests in a minute than allowed. See the Retry-After header. `refused`: Any other refusal the web server itself makes. `server_error`: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

message.description: A plain sentence. Safe to show to the household.

entry.description: Position of the entry in the request, from 0.

field.description: Empty when the whole table is the problem.

message.description: What this helper may use, in a plain sentence.

private_details.description: Always false in v1: private details are never shared.

suggestions_per_day.description: Most suggested rows per UTC day.

review_queue_limit.description: Most suggestions from this helper that may wait on Review at once. A POST that would go over is refused whole (`review_queue_full`).

suggestions_waiting.description: How many of this helper's suggestions are waiting on Review now. Spreadsheet imports never count.

type.description: text, number, measure, money, boolean, date, choice, link, links, file and so on.

to.description: Link columns: the table linked to.

note.description: Money columns: send and read whole units, like 12.50.

worked_out.description: Columns the program works out itself; never suggest them.

private_columns_left_out.description: How many private columns exist. Their names are not given.

reason.description: Why `can_suggest` is false, when it is.

Value.description: Text, a number, true/false, null, or a list of record ids for a `links` column. Dates are ISO (2026-11-17). Money is whole units, like 12.50. Choices are their key.

source.description: Who added it: a person, `import:<file>` or `agent:<helper>`.

values.description: Column name to value. GET /tables says which names to expect. Private columns and links into parts not given are never here.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` for the next page, or null at the end.

table.description: A table name from GET /tables, like `pets__weigh_ins`.

values.description: Column name to value, as GET /tables describes. Never private, worked-out or system fields.

request_key.description: Your own label for this request. Sending the same key and body again returns the first answer and adds nothing.

why.description: One sentence for the household: where this came from.
